text:
marta: Quick non-work poll — pick one: a) a soundtrack you can listen to on loop (guilty pleasure), or b) one book you’d push on someone for a weekend? I can't decide. :thinking:
ryan: Soundtrack: Danger Mouse & Daniele Luppi — 'Rome' (sooo underrated). Book: 'The Sparrow' by Mary Doria Russell. both vibe-y.
jess: Ooh 'Rome' rec! I'll add movie score edge: 'Only Lovers Left Alive' OST — mood.
owen: Book rec: 'The Long Way to a Small, Angry Planet' for pure comfort sci-fi. @marta vote: soundtrack
sophia: Book: 'Klara and the Sun' — quick, weirdly comforting. soundtrack: anything by Trent Reznor/Atticus Ross for late-night coding :headphones:
lisa: Poll result so far: soundtrack 2, book 2. also: guilty pop pick — Britney '…Baby One More Time' is my repeat shame. :sweat_smile:
jess: haha same. guilty-pleasure single: 'Call Me Maybe'.
ryan: Also, lesser-known film score rec: Ryuichi Sakamoto's 'The Last Emperor' OST — beautiful.
marta: adding a bonus: audiobook rec? 'The Night Watchman' read by the author is lovely.
bookbot: Recommended: 'The Left Hand of Darkness' — classic if you like introspective SF. (auto-rec)
owen: If we had to pick one for the thread winner — soundtrack: Sakamoto. book: 'The Long Way...' Vote by emoji :thumbsup: for soundtrack, :book: for book.
sophia: :thumbsup: (soundtrack)
lisa: :book: (book)
jess: :thumbsup: 
ryan: :thumbsup:
marta: :book:
owen: Tally — soundtrack 3, book 2. soundtrack wins, narrowly. thanks for the recs, team! :tada:
marta: Let's do another round next week — movie scores vs guilty pop singles? :popcorn:
